positions.question: Do you support expanding federal funding to support social safety net programs such as Social Security and Medicare?

evidence.text: "Social Security has been raided for years by the Federal Government. The government needs to replace what it has taken from Social Security. Unfortunately Social Security is the biggest Ponzi scheme in the world. American Citizens should be able to collect what they paid in plus a reasonable interest, but it is not set up this way. It is set up so that current workers pay the retirements of retired workers."

positions.question: Do you support increasing security along the southern US border?

evidence.text: "Our border needs to be closed! Build a wall and secure it with technology and with an armed presence on our side of the border. Securing our border is mandated by the Constitution and that needs to be enforced. To not secure our border is treason and needs to be treated as such. A nation without borders is not a nation and I am not in support of a North American Union similar to the European Union. When it comes to legal immigration we should be strictly following the laws that are in the books regarding accepting immigrants into this country."
